textsForReview.value: 10 inputs: SMA ground referenced; DC preserved; open input returns near GND, ADC near 1.647V.
Nominal VADC = 1.6472868 - 0.7 x VIN (50-ohm loading ~0.05%); calibrate gain/offset and sign.
Signal LPF poles ~4.72kHz and 5.68kHz; ADC reservoir 47ohm / 10nF. No 1MHz passband.
Start with ADC acquisition >=8us; verify actual sample time / settling. Firmware is not changed here.
Common offset, negative supply and reference on 03_MCU_POWER. Powered-off/overvoltage inputs not qualified.
